item.title: Youth and Community Development — Procurement: Technical Assistance for Dev. Safe & Supportive Environment
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
DYCD's capacity-building and technical assistance programs support DYCD s contracted providers in various areas needed to enhance program services. DYCD is issuing a Request for Proposal (RFP) in the areas of Organization Development, Fiscal Management, Strength-Based Approaches to Service Delivery, Career Development, Developing a Safe and Supportive Environment, Adult Literacy Support, Mental Health Support and Case Management. These services have been determined to be of high need to support our contracted providers and the work they do for the City of New York.

item.title: Design and Construction — Procurement: LNXA20WKF, Wakefield Library ADA Renovation
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
The Department of Design and Construction is seeking a Special Inspector to provide special inspection services for the LNXA20WKF - Wakefield Library ADA Renovation - Special Inspections project. This Project consists of adding an accessible ramp and plaza to the front entry, exterior lighting, making the vestibule and entry doors accessible, upgrading the first-floor toilet room to be accessible and making the cellar ramp accessible. A new sidewalk will be constructed at the front side of library for better accessibility. Please see RFI Form, project specific agreement, and bidset drawings
